notes.note: Removing testosterone's C19 methyl group produces nandrolone (19-nortestosterone), not trenbolone. Trenbolone is actually a derivative of nandrolone with two additional double bonds (Δ9,11), making it more heavily modified than testosterone minus one carbon.
notes.claim: Trenbolone is testosterone with a carbon atom removed.
notes.context_quote: Tren is testosterone with this carbon atom removed.
notes.context_paragraph: Steroids are for the most part different flavors of testosterone. Tren is testosterone with this carbon atom removed. Nandrlone is the same thing but with a few less double bonds and test propionate and anthypate are all literally just testosterone with an estrogen added at different lengths which impacts how quickly it's released into your system.

sources.quote: Nandrolone is chemically known as 19-nortestosterone. It is very close to testosterone in terms of chemical structure, the only difference between the two compounds being that the C19 methyl group of testosterone has been removed in the case of nandrolone.
sources.explanation: This confirms that removing the C19 methyl group from testosterone results in nandrolone, directly contradicting the post's claim that this process produces trenbolone.

sources.explanation: This proves that trenbolone is a derivative of nandrolone (not vice versa) and that it requires two additional double bonds, making it more modified than just a 'testosterone with one carbon removed'.
